remarks: Welcome to your new to be built custom home! Price improved! The new plan is a modern ranch offering a smaller, more efficient floor plan — the same quality and craftsmanship at a reduced price. This beautifully designed ranch home offers the ultimate convenience with a first-floor primary bedroom, and private en-suite bath. It includes 3 bedrooms and 2 baths on a peaceful half-acre lot. Imagine sipping your favorite beverage on the covered back patio in your private setting. Inside, you'll love the elegance and durability of luxury vinyl flooring throughout the first floor, plus the everyday convenience of a first-floor laundry. The eat-in kitchen features a large island — ideal for meals and entertaining. Just minutes from the Village of Alden with easy access to shops, dining, and top-rated schools. Customize colors, finishes, and upgrades to make it yours. Embrace modern farmhouse charm, comfort, and convenience. Schedule a consultation with Marzec Homes today!
